item.title: The Great Lakes are covered in ice; how can this effect weather in Michiana?
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- All five of the Great Lakes have more ice coverage than typical; including Lake Erie, which may completely freeze over in the coming days.

item.title: Elkhart basset hound wins Puppy Bowl 'Pupularity Playoffs'
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Animal Planet announced Rhett the basset hound as the winner of this year's Puppy Bowl "Pupularity Playoffs."

item.title: Father arrested in Starke County AMBER alert, 2-year-old son found safe
item.description: NORTH JUDSON, Ind. -- The Starke County Sheriff's Department reports the suspect in the Friday morning statewide AMBER alert for a North Judson boy is in custody after a morning standoff with the FBI and several other local police departments.

item.title: Afternoon shooting leaves one injured in Michigan City
item.description: MICHIGAN CITY, Ind. -- The Michigan City Police Department reports officers responded to a shooting in the 400 block of Chicago Street around 3:17 p.m., Friday.

item.title: La Porte County PTO treasurer charged with Theft following investigation
item.description: LA PORTE COUNTY, Ind. -- The La Porte County Sheriff's Office reports a suspect turned herself in on Friday after being named a suspect in a theft investigation regarding the Kingsbury Parent Teacher Organization account and associated monies.

item.title: More than $2M in grants to help employers improve workforce
item.description: BERRIEN COUNTY, Ind. -- More than two million dollars in state grant money is being distributed to employers in southwest Michigan.

item.title: Ice Fest taking shape this weekend in St. Joseph
item.description: St. Joseph, Mich. — Ice Fest is taking over the streets of Downtown St. Joe this Friday and Saturday! ABC57’s Jackie Bauer checked out some of the ice sculptures already on display sponsored by local businesses who are exciting to see visitors come to the Beach Town in the winter months.

item.title: Raclin Murphy Encore Center officially open for business
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind — The long awaited, highly anticipated Raclin Murphy Encore Center is open for business as of Friday morning. It's been in the making for years, with initial ideas and plans dating back to 2019, pre covid.

item.title: Indiana Donor Network saves over 1,000 lives through organ donation in 2025
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS -- In 2025 alone, Indiana Donor Network saved a total of 1,214 lives with the help of organ and tissue donation.

item.title: Owner shares reason behind controversial Elkhart Black History Month display
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — A Black History Month display in Elkhart generated a lot of buzz in the community and on social media Friday, with many community members having questions.
